hooks.command: BR=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$BR" ]; then echo '{}'; exit 0; fi; OUT=$(git fetch origin "$BR" 2>&1 && git pull --rebase --autostash origin "$BR" 2>&1); EC=$?; if [ $EC -ne 0 ]; then MSG="auto-sync FAILED on $BR - resolve manually"; elif echo "$OUT" | grep -qE 'up.to.date|Already up to date'; then MSG="auto-sync: up to date on $BR"; else MSG="auto-sync: pulled latest on $BR"; fi; printf '{"systemMessage":"%s"}\n' "$MSG"
